SELECT n.normative_ref,
    n.title,
    n.authority,
    n.authority_class,
    n.official_uri,
    n.applicability,
    n.binding_status,
    n.full_text_storage_policy,
    n.verified_at,
    n.attributes,
    e.raw_evidence_id,
    e.raw_sha256,
    e.raw_byte_count,
    e.text_sha256,
    e.text_char_count,
    e.mask_sha256,
    e.extraction_status,
    e.identity_hint_match,
    e.extractor_version,
    e.publication_mode,
    e.canonical_promotion
   FROM cko_governance.normative_reference_catalog n
     LEFT JOIN cfc_internal_normative_extractions e ON e.instrument_id = n.normative_ref
  WHERE n.normative_ref ~~ 'CFC-%'::text AND (n.attributes ->> 'lifecycle'::text) = 'VIGENTE'::text;

SELECT sample_id,
    assertion_candidate_id,
    normalized_unit_id,
    primary_stratum,
    normative_family,
    unit_type,
    lexical_signal_count,
    multi_signal,
    text_len,
    sample_order,
    annotation_status,
    maintainer_validation_status,
    blind_reveal_status,
    sample_hash
   FROM account_palm.atomization_eval_sample_v1
  WHERE set_type = 'BLIND'::text;

SELECT s.sample_id AS evaluation_item_id,
    'ORIGINAL_GOLD'::text AS sample_origin,
    NULL::text AS replaced_sample_id,
    s.assertion_candidate_id,
    s.normalized_unit_id,
    s.primary_stratum,
    s.normative_family,
    s.unit_type,
    s.lexical_signal_count,
    s.multi_signal,
    s.text_len,
    s.annotation_status,
    s.maintainer_validation_status,
    n.instrument_id,
    n.normative_work_id,
    n.locator,
    n.page_start,
    n.page_end,
    n.normalized_text,
    n.normalized_text_sha256,
    n.source_text_sha256,
    n.mask_sha256
   FROM account_palm.atomization_eval_sample_v1 s
     JOIN account_palm.normalized_units_v1 n USING (normalized_unit_id)
  WHERE s.set_type = 'GOLD'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM account_palm.atomization_gold_replacements_v1 r
          WHERE r.replaced_sample_id = s.sample_id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT r.replacement_sample_id AS evaluation_item_id,
    'REPLACEMENT_GOLD'::text AS sample_origin,
    r.replaced_sample_id,
    r.assertion_candidate_id,
    r.normalized_unit_id,
    r.primary_stratum,
    r.normative_family,
    r.unit_type,
    r.lexical_signal_count,
    r.multi_signal,
    r.text_len,
    r.annotation_status,
    r.maintainer_validation_status,
    n.instrument_id,
    n.normative_work_id,
    n.locator,
    n.page_start,
    n.page_end,
    n.normalized_text,
    n.normalized_text_sha256,
    n.source_text_sha256,
    n.mask_sha256
   FROM account_palm.atomization_gold_replacements_v1 r
     JOIN account_palm.normalized_units_v1 n USING (normalized_unit_id);

SELECT s.sample_id,
    s.assertion_candidate_id,

    s.primary_stratum,

SELECT s.sample_id,

SELECT 'AUDIT_EDUCA'::text AS project,
    'ACCOUNT_PALM'::text AS subproject,
    'ACCOUNTING_AUDIT'::text AS domain,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.active_normative_references) AS active_norms,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.lifecycle_nonactive
          WHERE (lifecycle_nonactive.attributes ->> 'canonical_lifecycle_bucket'::text) = 'REVOKED'::text) AS revoked_norms,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.lifecycle_nonactive
          WHERE (lifecycle_nonactive.attributes ->> 'canonical_lifecycle_bucket'::text) = 'CORRECTION_EVENT'::text) AS correction_events,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.normative_works) AS normative_works,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.referenced_works) AS referenced_works,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.relation_candidates) AS relation_candidates,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.relation_candidates
          WHERE relation_candidates.terminal_status = 'HOLD_SCOPED'::text) AS relation_holds,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.strong_relation_candidates
          WHERE strong_relation_candidates.terminal_status = 'PASS'::text) AS strong_relations_pass,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.master_register) AS master_register_rows,
    'NO_NURSING_OR_HEALTH_DOMAIN_CONSOLIDATION'::text AS scope_guard,
    now() AS observed_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_palm.normalized_units_v1) AS normalized_units,
    ( SELECT normalization_runs_v1.status

    max(d.year) AS year,

    bool_or(d.official_url IS NOT NULL) AS has_official_url,
    bool_or(d.has_full_text) AS has_full_text,
    bool_or(d.resolved_canonical_id IS NOT NULL) AS identity_resolved,
    bool_or(d.promoted_canonical_id IS NOT NULL) AS promoted,
    bool_or(i.instrument_id IS NOT NULL) AS regulatory_candidate_materialized,
    count(DISTINCT s.snapshot_id) AS snapshot_count,
    count(DISTINCT r.relationship_id) FILTER (WHERE r.source_id = d.resolved_canonical_id OR r.target_id = d.resolved_canonical_id) AS relationship_count,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN NOT bool_or(d.official_url IS NOT NULL) THEN 'MISSING_OFFICIAL_URL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT bool_or(d.has_full_text) THEN 'MISSING_FULL_TEXT_SNAPSHOT'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT bool_or(d.resolved_canonical_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'MISSING_CANONICAL_IDENTITY'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or(d.resolved_canonical_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT bool_or(i.instrument_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'REGULATORY_CANDIDATE_NOT_MATERIALIZED'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or(i.instrument_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT bool_or(d.promoted_canonical_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'PENDING_REGULATORY_PROMOTION'::text
            ELSE NULL::text

   FROM cko_regulatory.discovery_candidates d
     LEFT JOIN cko_regulatory.instruments i ON i.canonical_id = d.resolved_canonical_id
     LEFT JOIN cko_evidence.snapshots s ON s.snapshot_id = i.current_snapshot_id

WITH aud AS (
         SELECT b.layer_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE a_1.mandatory) AS required_lenses,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE a_1.mandatory AND (b.audit_status = ANY (ARRAY['PASS'::text, 'PASS_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS'::text, 'PASS_WITH_SCOPED_HOLDS'::text]))) AS passed_lenses,
            jsonb_object_agg(b.lens_id, b.audit_status ORDER BY a_1.lens_order) AS lens_statuses,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE a_1.mandatory AND b.audit_status = 'PASS_WITH_SCOPED_HOLDS'::text) AS scoped_lens_count
           FROM cko_validation.layer_audit_bindings b
             JOIN cko_validation.audit_lenses a_1 ON a_1.lens_id = b.lens_id
          GROUP BY b.layer_id
        ), dep AS (
         SELECT d.layer_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AS dependency_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND NOT (COALESCE(da.required_lenses, 0::bigint) > 0 AND da.required_lenses = da.passed_lenses)) AS blocking_dependency_count,
            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('dependency_id', d.dependency_id, 'depends_on', d.depends_on_layer_id, 'kind', d.dependency_kind, 'scope', d.blocking_scope, 'dependency_audit',
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(da.required_lenses, 0::bigint) > 0 AND da.required_lenses = da.passed_lenses AND COALESCE(da.scoped_lens_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'PASS_WITH_SCOPED_HOLDS'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(da.required_lenses, 0::bigint) > 0 AND da.required_lenses = da.passed_lenses THEN 'PASS'::text
                    ELSE 'NOT_PASS'::text
                END) ORDER BY d.depends_on_layer_id) FILTER (WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE'::text), '[]'::jsonb) AS dependency_statuses,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND COALESCE(da.scoped_lens_count, 0::bigint) > 0) AS scoped_dependency_count
           FROM cko_governance.layer_dependencies d
             LEFT JOIN aud da ON da.layer_id = d.depends_on_layer_id
          GROUP BY d.layer_id
        )
 SELECT l.layer_id,
    l.layer_name,
    l.flow_sequence,
    NULL::text AS next_layer_id,
    COALESCE(a.required_lenses, 0::bigint) AS required_lenses,
    COALESCE(a.passed_lenses, 0::bigint) AS passed_lenses,
    a.lens_statuses,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(dep.blocking_dependency_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'BLOCKED_BY_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(a.required_lenses, 0::bigint) > 0 AND a.required_lenses = a.passed_lenses THEN
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(a.scoped_lens_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'OWN_AUDIT_PASS_WITH_SCOPED_HOLDS'::text
                ELSE 'OWN_AUDIT_PASS'::text
            END
            ELSE 'READY_TO_EXECUTE_OWN_PIPELINE'::text
        END AS progression_status,
    COALESCE(dep.dependency_count, 0::bigint) AS dependency_count,
    COALESCE(dep.blocking_dependency_count, 0::bigint) AS blocking_dependency_count,
    COALESCE(dep.dependency_statuses, '[]'::jsonb) AS dependency_statuses,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_governance.scoped_holds h
          WHERE h.owner_layer_id = l.layer_id AND h.status = 'ACTIVE'::text), 0::bigint) AS scoped_hold_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(dep.blocking_dependency_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'BLOCKED'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(a.scoped_lens_count, 0::bigint) > 0 OR COALESCE(dep.scoped_dependency_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'REQUIRES_SCOPED_HOLD_EVALUATION'::text
            ELSE 'NO_LAYER_LEVEL_HOLD'::text
        END AS promotion_gate_status
   FROM cko_governance.layer_catalog l
     LEFT JOIN aud a ON a.layer_id = l.layer_id
     LEFT JOIN dep ON dep.layer_id = l.layer_id;

    f.required_authority_classes,
    ARRAY( SELECT x.x
           FROM unnest(f.required_normative_refs) x(x)
          WHERE NOT (x.x = ANY (COALESCE(bs.active_refs, '{}'::text[])))) AS missing_required_normative_refs,
    ARRAY( SELECT x.x
           FROM unnest(f.required_authority_classes) x(x)
          WHERE NOT (x.x = ANY (COALESCE(bs.active_classes, '{}'::text[])))) AS missing_required_authority_classes,
        CASE
            WHEN f.gate_effect = 'NOT_APPLICABLE_JUSTIFIED'::text THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE_JUSTIFIED'::text
            WHEN cardinality(ARRAY( SELECT x.x
               FROM unnest(f.required_normative_refs) x(x)
              WHERE NOT (x.x = ANY (COALESCE(bs.active_refs, '{}'::text[]))))) > 0 THEN 'HOLD_MISSING_REQUIRED_NORMATIVE_REF'::text
            WHEN cardinality(ARRAY( SELECT x.x
               FROM unnest(f.required_authority_classes) x(x)
              WHERE NOT (x.x = ANY (COALESCE(bs.active_classes, '{}'::text[]))))) > 0 THEN 'HOLD_MISSING_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY_CLASS'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(bs.active_blocking_binding_count, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'BOUND'::text
            ELSE 'HOLD_MISSING_BLOCKING_AUTHORITY'::text
        END AS authority_gate_status
   FROM cko_governance.field_catalog f
     LEFT JOIN binding_sets bs ON bs.field_id = f.field_id;

WITH d AS (
         SELECT count(*)::integer AS tools_total,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_registry_v2_candidate.identity_status = 'IDENTITY_RESOLVED'::text)::integer AS tools_identity_resolved,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_registry_v2_candidate.field_count > 0)::integer AS tools_with_fields,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_registry_v2_candidate.field_count = 0)::integer AS tools_without_fields,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_registry_v2_candidate.canonical_promotion_allowed)::integer AS tools_promotion_allowed
           FROM cko_governance.md_tool_registry_v2_candidate
        ), f AS (
         SELECT count(*)::integer AS fields_total,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.primitive_type = ANY (ARRAY['decimal'::text, 'integer'::text, 'number'::text])) OR md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.html_type = 'number'::text)::integer AS numeric_fields,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.min_value_text IS NOT NULL)::integer AS fields_with_min,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.max_value_text IS NOT NULL)::integer AS fields_with_max,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.step_value_text IS NOT NULL)::integer AS fields_with_step,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.allow_negative IS NOT NULL)::integer AS fields_with_negative_rule,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.pattern_regex IS NOT NULL OR md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.allowed_characters_policy IS NOT NULL)::integer AS fields_with_character_rule,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.validation_completeness_status = 'PASS_CONTRACT_COMPLETE'::text)::integer AS fields_contract_complete,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate.validation_completeness_status ~~ 'HOLD%'::text)::integer AS fields_hold
           FROM cko_governance.md_tool_field_contract_v2_candidate
        )
 SELECT d.tools_total,
    d.tools_identity_resolved,
    d.tools_with_fields,
    d.tools_without_fields,
    d.tools_promotion_allowed,
    f.fields_total,
    f.numeric_fields,
    f.fields_with_min,
    f.fields_with_max,
    f.fields_with_step,
    f.fields_with_negative_rule,
    f.fields_with_character_rule,
    f.fields_contract_complete,
    f.fields_hold
   FROM d
     CROSS JOIN f;

WITH a AS (
         SELECT count(*) AS assertion_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE assertions.source_fragment_id IS NOT NULL) AS assertions_with_fragment,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE assertions.source_fragment_id IS NULL) AS assertions_without_fragment
           FROM cko_evidence.assertions
        ), c AS (
         SELECT count(*) AS claim_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(claims.evidence_refs) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_array_length(claims.evidence_refs) > 0) AS claims_with_evidence,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(claims.assertion_refs) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_array_length(claims.assertion_refs) > 0) AS claims_with_assertions,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(claims.evidence_refs) = 'array'::text THEN claims.evidence_refs
                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                END), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(claims.assertion_refs) = 'array'::text THEN claims.assertion_refs
                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                END), 0) = 0) AS claims_without_support_refs,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE claims.status = 'CONTROLLED_CANDIDATE'::text) AS candidate_claims,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE claims.human_review_required) AS human_review_required_claims
           FROM cko_evidence.claims
        )
 SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_evidence.sources) AS source_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_evidence.snapshots) AS snapshot_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_evidence.fragments) AS fragment_count,
    a.assertion_count,
    a.assertions_with_fragment,
    a.assertions_without_fragment,
    c.claim_count,
    c.claims_with_evidence,
    c.claims_with_assertions,
    c.claims_without_support_refs,
    c.candidate_claims,
    c.human_review_required_claims,
        CASE
            WHEN a.assertion_count = 0 AND c.claim_count = 0 THEN 'REAL_SEMANTIC_MATERIALIZATION_GAP'::text
            WHEN c.claims_without_support_refs > 0 THEN 'HOLD_UNSUPPORTED_CLAIMS'::text
            ELSE 'MATERIALIZED_REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_REPERFORMANCE'::text
        END AS semantic_state,
    'Assertions/claims are evidence-supported candidates; counts are not targets and semantic statements may not be fabricated for coverage.'::text AS scope_note
   FROM a,
    c;

SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_flow.processes) AS process_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_flow.events) AS event_count,
    count(*) AS lineage_edge_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE reversible) AS reversible_edges,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM provenance_ref), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AS edges_with_provenance,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM source_ref), ''::text) IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM target_ref), ''::text) IS NULL) AS structurally_invalid_edges,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'NO_LINEAGE_MATERIALIZED'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM source_ref), ''::text) IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM target_ref), ''::text) IS NULL) > 0 THEN 'HOLD_STRUCTURAL_LINEAGE_GAPS'::text
            ELSE 'STRUCTURAL_LINEAGE_PRESENT_REQUIRES_OBJECT_RESOLUTION_TEST'::text
        END AS lineage_state,
    'Structural lineage is not full Digital Twin coverage; forward/reverse object resolution and affected-set completeness require scoped CAAT.'::text AS scope_note
   FROM cko_flow.lineage_edges;

SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_regulatory.instruments) AS instrument_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cko_regulatory.provisions) AS provision_count,
    count(*) AS applicability_rows,
    count(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM rationale), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AS rows_with_rationale,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM provenance_ref), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AS rows_with_provenance,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM confidence), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AS rows_with_confidence,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CONTROLLED_CANDIDATE'::text) AS candidate_rows,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'REAL_MATERIALIZATION_GAP'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM rationale), ''::text) IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM provenance_ref), ''::text) IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM confidence), ''::text) IS NULL) > 0 THEN 'HOLD_INCOMPLETE_APPLICABILITY_ROWS'::text
            ELSE 'MATERIALIZED_REQUIRES_SCOPE_COVERAGE_TEST'::text
        END AS materialization_state,
    'No regulatory coverage percentage is asserted until the applicable subject universe is explicitly defined. UNKNOWN applicability remains HOLD and may not be inferred.'::text AS scope_note
   FROM cko_regulatory.applicability;

WITH src AS (
         SELECT count(*) AS source_count
           FROM cko_evidence.sources
        ), snap AS (
         SELECT count(*) AS snapshot_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM snapshots.content_sha256), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AS snapshots_with_hash,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM snapshots.content_sha256), ''::text) IS NULL) AS snapshots_without_hash,
            count(DISTINCT snapshots.source_id) AS sources_with_snapshot
           FROM cko_evidence.snapshots
        ), frag AS (
         SELECT count(*) AS fragment_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM fragments.fragment_sha256), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AS fragments_with_hash,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM fragments.fragment_sha256), ''::text) IS NULL) AS fragments_without_hash
           FROM cko_evidence.fragments
        ), orphan AS (
         SELECT count(*) AS orphan_fragments
           FROM cko_evidence.fragments f
             LEFT JOIN cko_evidence.snapshots s ON s.snapshot_id = f.snapshot_id
          WHERE s.snapshot_id IS NULL
        )
 SELECT src.source_count,
    snap.snapshot_count,
    snap.sources_with_snapshot,
    GREATEST(src.source_count - snap.sources_with_snapshot, 0::bigint) AS sources_without_snapshot,
    snap.snapshots_with_hash,
    snap.snapshots_without_hash,
    frag.fragment_count,
    frag.fragments_with_hash,
    frag.fragments_without_hash,
    orphan.orphan_fragments,
        CASE
            WHEN orphan.orphan_fragments = 0 AND snap.snapshots_without_hash = 0 AND frag.fragments_without_hash = 0 THEN 'STRUCTURAL_INTEGRITY_PASS_FOR_MATERIALIZED_ROWS'::text
            ELSE 'HOLD_STRUCTURAL_INTEGRITY_GAPS'::text
        END AS structural_state,
    'Does not require every registered source to have a snapshot: metadata-only/pending sources may be valid; scope-specific acquisition coverage is evaluated separately.'::text AS scope_note
   FROM src,
    snap,
    frag,
    orphan;

SELECT normative_ref,
    title,
    authority,
    authority_class,
    official_uri,
    applicability,
    binding_status,

   FROM cko_governance.normative_reference_catalog
  WHERE authority = 'Conselho Federal de Contabilidade'::text AND binding_status = 'ACTIVE_REFERENCE'::text AND COALESCE((attributes ->> 'internal_only'::text)::boolean, false) = true;

SELECT node_id,
